Got up to Difficulty 4 before review: This is so good, I'd want a DRM free version. Excellent game. Could use a little more variety in regards to towers. Some elements are isolated to one good function, limiting some of the variety. For example, Fire isn't that good as a damage dealer. It can do it, but it's not nearly as effective as Wind or an enhanced Sprinkler.

Really nice game if you like puzzles about optimizing little spaces to fit as many things as possible. I like how, unlike other rogue-likes, it allows you to retry your last fight to test other possibilities in order to minimize how much permanent damage you recieve and / or to try to squeeze a narrow victory instead of having to reset back to the start. While a bit short when compared with other games, for a FREE TO PLAY game it has quite a bit of content if you want to unlock and beat a maximum difficulty run.

Charming game, gameplay loop is good overall. I've gotten to Pressure 7 but I do have a few minor nitpicks. 1. There are several spelling errors such as Strength -> Stranth 2. Music could use more tracks 3. Cocoon feels underpowered (I might have just had poor RNG across several runs)

I can't believe I played this peak for free. It's a bit complicated at first, but once you get the hang of it, it becomes very rewarding. The main game ends quickly, but there's also an endless mode. It's a shame there's no Steam Workshop or multisave.
